question: Does the actual original local charge source have an all-time opposite-charge response symmetry, and which uniform chemical markings remain visible to charged corners despite a total-zero starting sector?
scope: Original finite-volume Round20 onsite field algebra and scalar-coupled native Hamiltonian, with a charge-conjugation-invariant start. Exact source-specific response obstruction to one fixed marked chiral twist; not a universal source no-go.
summary_de: Die tatsächliche bilineare Cocycle-Quelle besitzt C T_p C=T_-p und C W_p C=W_p*. Das Vorzeichen T_p*=(-1)^e(p)T_-p bleibt erhalten. Quadratische Energie, Skalarteil und Hopping sind C-invariant; damit sind entgegengesetzte adjungiert-gepaarte Feldantworten bei C-invariantem Start für alle Zeiten gleich. Ein fester nichttrivialer chiraler Vierteltwist hat dagegen Ratio exp(-2tδ·p). Uniforme chemische Markierung ist auf C0 null, wird aber in geladenen onsite Einfüge/Entferne-Ecken sichtbar; C0 ist kein Argument gegen alle lokalen Ladungsproben.
summary_en: The actual bilinear-cocycle source has C T_p C=T_-p and C W_p C=W_p*. The sign T_p*=(-1)^e(p)T_-p is retained. Quadratic energy, scalar dynamics and hopping are C invariant, so opposite-charge adjoint-paired responses at a C-invariant start agree at all times. A fixed nonzero chiral quarter twist instead has ratio exp(-2tδ·p). A uniform chemical marking vanishes within C0 but remains visible in charged onsite insertion/removal corners; C0 does not remove all local charge probes.
assumptions: The original full tensor_x l2(E8) field source, frozen bilinear cocycle, finite lattice, eight arithmetic hops and given scalar/charge Hamiltonian.
A C-invariant starting density, including the given full or sector Gibbs states. Arbitrary broken-symmetry starts are outside the symmetry conclusion.
For the chiral comparison, the fixed primary vacuum, opposite marked charges, common time normalization and already stipulated chiral E8 representation.
Chemical eta is an additional comparison input; charged onsite insertions require full exterior-sector propagation, not a fictitious T endomorphism of C0.
positive_results: Actual source C symmetry extends from the exact cocycle to the original selfadjoint Hamiltonian, its Gibbs states and all C-conjugate bounded multitime words.
C0 retains balanced local W dynamics and charged corners for onsite T; it is not a blanket local-observable blindness statement.

For C0-supported invariant starts, H_eta=H+eta.Q gives exact charged return ratio exp(-2t eta.p), although sector-internal dynamics is unchanged. Eta=B^Tdelta is only the conditional linear coordinate dictionary.

For arbitrary fixed Peierls link phases and flux, A=C times complex conjugation preserves the original hopping source. A-invariant full/C0 Gibbs starts retain equal positive Euclidean opposite-charge return responses; no arbitrary real-time equality is asserted.
kills: Identifying all opposite marked charged responses of the unchanged C-invariant native source/start with one fixed asymmetric nonzero chiral twist.
Dropping the actual T adjoint cocycle sign.
Treating onsite T as an operator within C0 or inferring all local charge probes are blind from global neutrality.
Calling a stipulated chemical marking or symmetric +/-twist mixture a source-selected physical solution.
Repairing this asymmetric Euclidean charged-pair target solely by fixed Peierls/quarter phases at an A-invariant start.
leaves_open: Derive the original physical source, state and any C-breaking marking from P1/P2.
Construct an actual marked local operator/state/time dictionary or another source realization; equality of one odd response factor is insufficient.
Physical detector/preparation access, instrument/event selection and all T1-T8 gates.
